note: Use induction on n=|X|. Necessity follows by injecting each S into N(S) along matching edges. For sufficiency, if a nonempty proper tight A exists, match A inside A union N(A), then prove Hall in the residual graph by applying Hall to A union T. Otherwise every nonempty proper T has at least |T|+1 neighbors; choose any edge xy, delete x and y, and apply induction. The n=1 case is covered because the strict-proper-subset condition is vacuous and Hall gives a neighbor of x.
